nos_units.nos_title: Erect and dismantle temporary scaffold up to 3.6 meter
kus: KU1. the use of different types of scaffolds (e.g. cup-lock, frame scaffold)
KU2. the use of tools and tackles in scaffolding, including tools for erecting and dismantling 3.6
KU3. the identification and use of different scaffolding components
KU4. the standard size of scaffolding components
KU5. the standard procedure for erecting and dismantling 3.6 m temporary scaffold

GS2. read the appropriate reports and literature concerning the field of work

modules.module_title: Erect and dismantle temporary scaffold

pcs.pc_description: carry out levelling in the area where scaffold needs to be erected and check for ground compactness
shift and stack the materials, components, tools and tackles required for erecting scaffolding, at the identified location
place base plates and sole boards on the ground as per the markings and given instructions
use appropriate components and follow the standard procedure for erecting temporary scaffold up to 3.6 m in height
assist in checking the verticality of scaffold at the first level of erection and take appropriate corrective measures, as required, before moving to the next level
assist in checking the rigidity, stability and support of erected scaffold
set up walk-boards, guard rails, toe-boards and other components on the scaffold’s working platform
follow the standard procedure for dismantling the temporary scaffold, i.e. removing guard rails, toe boards, walk boards and other components sequentially
clean and stack all components properly after dismantling
follow the recommended safety measures, including the use of appropriate PPE and being careful while working on heights

modules.module_title: Prepare the base surfaces

pcs.pc_description: assist in taking surface measurements and estimating the quantity of required materials
check the surface is free from dust, dirt and grease and is prepared appropriately for the application of paint
apply putty appropriately to fill gaps and depressions on the surface to get a level surface
cover the adjacent surfaces with drop cloths/ masking tape/paper and remove all removable items before painting

modules.module_title: Prepare the paint mix

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate painting material ,tools and mixing ingredients as per the supervisor’s instructions
prepare the painting tools and equipment for use through cleaning and maintenance
prepare the mix paint and additives using them in the specified ratio
follow the appropriate procedure for effective mixing and dilution of paint under supervision
use reducer or thinner to adjust the viscosity of paint mix as per requirement/instructions

modules.module_title: Apply primer and paint

pcs.pc_description: apply primer coats to the finished/leveled surfaces as per instructions
apply main coat of paint over primer within the specified time-limit under supervision
clean the surface of each dried coat appropriately as per instructions before application of next coat
apply final coat as per the required tint under supervision
apply the final tinted coat under supervision

modules.module_title: Prepare the base surfaces for varnishing and polishing

pcs.pc_description: remove all loose and detrimental foreign matter from the surface by using appropriate tools
apply bleaching agents on wooded surface using brush to restore the natural colour as per the supervisor’s instruction
fill the gaps/depressions on wooden surfaces using an appropriate wood filler
smoothen, shape, and touch-up the surface using sandpaper, pumice stones, steel wool, chisels, sanders, or grinders
cover the adjacent surfaces using drop cloth/ masking tape/paper and remove the removable items/accessories before varnishing and polishing

modules.module_title: Prepare the paint mix

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate finishing ingredients such as paint, stain, lacquer, shellac, or varnish as per specification/instructions
prepare the mix of paint and additives using them in the specified ratio
follow the appropriate procedure for effective mixing and dilution of paint under supervision
use reducer or thinner to adjust the viscosity of paint mix as per requirement/instructions

modules.module_title: Apply varnish and polish on wooden surfaces

pcs.pc_description: apply a primer coat to the wooden surface as per instruction
apply paint /varnish coat of specified thickness for the specified time after the primer dries as per the supervisor’s instructions
sand the surface using appropriate tools as per the given instructions
apply coat of putty/wood filler wood and sand the applied coat as per instructions
apply finishing coats as per instructions to produce a smooth surface of uniform thickness
apply toners, highlights, glazes/ shades, lacquers and sealers as instructed
